notice: Which chapter of the CURRENT NCERT book each NCERT Exemplar chapter belongs to. Decided against the current books' own contents pages and section headings, never by word overlap; a chapter with no single counterpart is null with its reason. Written by scripts/build_exemplar_chapter_map.py.
rule: A row maps when the current book of that class has exactly one chapter that teaches the Exemplar chapter's subject matter AND at most 10% of that chapter's questions are content the class teaches in another chapter; the measured share is in the note. Otherwise null: split, dropped, moved or residue.
